groups.label: Human subjects intend an act or event, often in an أَن clause
Human subjects seek a named object, reward, quality, or end
God as subject wills an act, condition, or effect

items.dominant: Human subjects express a desired end or intended action in 84 of 139 uses.

outside.how: Satan is the subject intending to mislead.
